description: split@1.1.0 parameters for the SSN pilot's held-out choices (K5, D32 starting values). Rows whose genre is held out go to test_unseen_genre, rows whose generator is held out to test_unseen_generator, rows held out on both to test_unseen_both; each directed split is proved disjoint from training (held_out_proof) at the step and again at finalize. No random held-out split is declared: split@1.1.0 refuses generated rows in any held-out split that is not value-directed (FR-002.31), so the calibration negatives come from screened real text in their own version (sizes.json) and any in-distribution validation split is drawn in miStudio. carrier_id and pair_id are group columns (connected components over both) so a carrier and its counterfactual siblings never straddle splits: slot_siblings@1 copies the carrier's carrier_id onto each sibling and writes pair_id = carrier_id on both (ENH-006 D89). Siblings exist only in training: the recipe drops siblings of a held-out genre or generator, so held-out splits stay free-form text (D89). Consequence accepted at the FTDD: every training carrier comes from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (served name); real text and the templated minority are the other training sources. The generator values must equal the generator column the carrier run writes: the model field of miLLM's reply, which is the served name /v1/models lists (bare, no organisation prefix; read 2026-10-25, Q5). generator is an identity column (TD-017.18): a revision suffix is ignored when the proof compares it.
